# Interview Follow-Up for Data Analyst Role

A polished, confident note that reinforces your experience and politely asks for an update after the final-round interview.

# Email Draft

**Subject:** Follow-Up on Final-Round Interview for Data Analyst Role

Dear Hiring Manager,

I hope you’re doing well. I wanted to thank you again for the opportunity to interview for the Data Analyst role and for the time your team spent speaking with me during the final round on March 18, 2026.

I remain very enthusiastic about the opportunity to contribute to your team. With 4 years of experience working across Excel, SQL, Tableau, and A/B testing, I’m confident I can bring a strong mix of analytical rigor, business insight, and clear communication to the role. I’m also especially interested in opportunities in Toronto, and I’m targeting a salary range of CAD 85,000–95,000.

I wanted to kindly check in on the status of the hiring process and ask whether there are any updates you can share regarding next steps. I understand these decisions can take time, and I appreciate your consideration.

Thank you again for your time and for the opportunity to be considered. I look forward to hearing from you.

Best regards,
[Your Full Name]
[Your Phone Number]
[Your Email Address]
